evidence.says: NOT the float timer of the rest of the family. Creator bg3.exe+0x32F92E0: ComponentFrameStorageAllocRaw(storage, 4) and writes 1 as a 32-bit integer at +0 (storage registered with element size 4). bg3.exe+0x32F8B60 (per-frame update of esv::unsheath::UserRequestSystem): for every entity in the system's request array it adds 1 to the 32-bit integer returned by bg3.exe+0x32F95A0 (the component) when the component exists, else creates it (=1); a second loop over the component storage (int stride 4) subtracts 1 once per pass, after adding esv::unsheath::UserRequestFailedOneFrameComponent (bg3.exe+0x32F9180) when field +0x10 of a 0x20-byte companion component is not 1; a third loop removes the component when the int at stride 4 is 0. A counter of user sheathe/unsheathe requests still being processed.

open_questions: The name Count is descriptive (no savegame model, not replicated). Which component is the 0x20-byte companion whose +0x10 decides the Failed signal was not named. ext_name avoids ServerUnsheathUserRequest, taken by the one-frame tag.
survey.second_pass: Width and offset settled on Windows: the creator bg3.exe+0x32F92E0 allocates 4 bytes and stores int 1, and the system update bg3.exe+0x32F8B60 increments, decrements and tests it for 0 as a 32-bit int with stride 4; the decrement loop also emits UserRequestFailedOneFrameComponent.
